entries.text: Fixed a `TypeError` raised by `Union` when combining an open `Interval` with a `FiniteSet` that contains both an endpoint of the interval and a symbolic element, e.g. `Union(Interval.open(-1, 1), FiniteSet(x, 1))`.

structured_output.reasoning: The diff changes the interval-union handler so it no longer uses Python membership tests that raise on undecidable symbolic membership, which fixes a user-visible TypeError. The linked umbrella issue says unmarked items behave the same on 1.14.0, so this is not a post-1.14 regression.
